description: A framework developed by the GRAD Partnership for organizing secondary-school supports around relationships, holistic data, strategic improvement actions, and student-centered mindsets.
title: GRAD Partnership Student Success Systems

description: A historical verbal-association and word-knowledge assessment developed by Harry A.
title: Graded 80-word opposites-test list with difficulty point values from .5 to 2.0 totaling 100 points

description: GradeOpt is a multi-agent LLM coding framework developed by Copur-Gencturk et al.
title: GradeOpt

description: A VR-based cognitive-training game developed by Zając-Lamparska and colleagues, with attention, memory, language, and visuospatial modules delivered through daily-life-inspired scenarios and adaptive difficulty levels.
title: GRADYS game

description: A combined dataset of three randomized classroom experiments with German secondary physics students comparing restudy with voice-message explanation after instruction on converging lenses, produced by Lachner et al.
title: GRAIL combined dataset of three classroom experiments on non-interactive teaching in optics

description: Grammar for Writing is a contextualised grammar-and-writing curriculum developed for teachers to improve Year 6 pupils' writing by linking linguistic choices to their effects on readers.
title: Grammar for Writing

description: A four-paragraph, 33-error test developed by Sahail M.
title: Grammatical error detection and correction test with 33 errors across eleven error types

description: A Python-based intelligent tutoring web application developed by Csépányi-Fürjes et al.
title: Graph4Learn (G4L) intelligent tutoring system

description: A 36-item assessment developed by Lowrie and colleagues to measure Grades 4–6 students' decoding of six graphical languages in mathematics, including number lines, graphs, maps, and diagrams.
title: Graphical Languages in Mathematics (GLIM) test

description: GraphoLearn is an adaptive digital reading game developed for young learners to practise phoneme discrimination, grapheme–phoneme correspondences, and early word decoding.
title: GraphoLearn (GL)

description: A 60-item Likert-scale assessment developed by Anthony Grasha to measure students' social-interaction learning-style preferences across independent-dependent, avoidant-participant, and collaborative-competitive dimensions; this study used a Turkish adaptation.
title: Grasha-Riechmann Learning Style Inventory

description: GraspLearn is a CD-ROM-based standalone graspable multimedia system developed by Kien Tsong Chau and colleagues for preschool English-as-a-second-language learning through interaction with RFID-enabled physical artefacts and corresponding virtual content.
title: GraspLearn

description: GRAVEN is a database of hand-gesture representations of neuroanatomical structures, nerves, vessels, and neurosurgical approaches developed for medical education and self-study.
title: GRAVEN database of hand-gesture representations of neuroanatomy

description: A nonprofit charter-school programme and school-design model run by Green Dot Public Schools that creates small community high schools organized around teacher support, autonomous leadership, college preparation, comprehensive student services, family engagement, and replicability.
title: Green Dot Public Schools

description: A 17-item reporting guideline developed by Phillips and colleagues for transparent reporting of evidence-based-practice educational interventions, used with its explanation-and-elaboration paper.
title: GREET checklist

description: The Group and representation tool (GRT), developed by Erkens, Bodemer, and Hoppe, transforms students' written text into variables to support heterogeneous group formation and cognitive group-awareness visualization.
title: Group and representation tool (GRT)

description: A paper-and-pencil embedded-figures assessment developed by Oltman, Raskin, and Witkin to measure field dependence–independence through identification of simple forms hidden in complex geometric figures.
title: Group Embedded Figures Test (GEFT)

description: A norm-referenced standardized mathematics assessment for first-grade learners, developed and administered to measure concepts and communication, operations and computation, process and applications, and total mathematics achievement.
title: Group Mathematics Assessment and Diagnostic Evaluation (GMADE) Level 1, Forms A and B

description: GrouPer is an AI-based student-grouping recommendation tool developed for teachers that uses unsupervised clustering of assessment responses to support formative analysis and assignment of adapted learning activities.
title: GrouPer

description: The Grow Network is a reporting platform operated by the Grow Network that transforms grades 3–9 assessment results into customized print and online reports, instructional resources, and parent-facing explanations for educators, principals, and families.
title: Grow Network

description: An expert-consensus framework developed by the GROW project that guides primary mathematics teachers through diagnosing needs, setting differentiated goals, differentiating instruction and practice, and evaluating progress.
title: GROW project

description: A year-long professional development programme run by educational consultants and school-based project coaches to develop primary teachers' competency in differentiated mathematics instruction through team meetings, coaching, lesson observation, and school-level implementation planning.
title: GROW teacher professional development programme

description: An Illinois state-funded programme that supports community members and prospective high school candidates in becoming certified teachers through scholarships and partnerships among school districts, preparation programmes, and community-based organizations.
title: Grow Your Own Illinois program

description: GroweLab is engage2learn's all-in-one coaching and talent-development platform for facilitating and documenting educator coaching and tracking professional-growth data and outcomes.
title: GroweLab

description: A national Irish longitudinal child-cohort dataset spanning ages 9, 13, and 17, with self-reported bullying exposure, Strengths and Difficulties Questionnaire scores, and Junior Certificate attainment measures.
title: Growing Up in Ireland Cohort'98 three-wave dataset with bullying item, SDQ, and Junior Certificate composite scores
